sections.brief: Aksum, Frumentius (consecrated by Athanasius, 328 or 340-346), Ezana's cross coins, Constantius's c.356 letter; Ge'ez Bible from the Septuagint, Garima Gospels; Tewahedo/miaphysite, accepts Nicaea-Constantinople-Ephesus, rejects Chalcedon; Coptic abunas to 1948/1951, autocephaly 28 June 1959; how 81 is counted: EOTC site 46+35, Cowley 1974 narrower 54+27 and broader 46+35 (both 81), Fetha Negest heading 81 vs list 73; full table of 81 books and the broader-canon additions.
